integrity: Analytical sign proof and reproducible symbolic checker; no computational result is substituted for the infinite-step proof.
scientific_limitations: One exact two-coordinate semidissipative generator; Euclidean one-step energy, not full accuracy, nonlinear stability, general oscillator ratios or higher dimensions; possible unlocated equivalent calculations.
title: Sharp Runge–Kutta energy thresholds on a rank-one damped oscillator
